hotel_name: The Lodge at Blue Sky, Auberge Collection

claims.text: The design is modern and organic, and cliffside accommodations overlook creeks and peaks.

findings.quote: Modern, organic design blends into the landscape, where cliffside accommodations overlook creeks and sunlit peaks.

claims.text: The Creek Houses are one-bedroom suites on the banks of Alexander Creek, a short walk from the Sky Lodge and Edge Spa.

findings.quote: The Creek Houses are open concept, one-bedroom suites situated along the tranquil banks of Alexander Creek, just a 3 minute walk from the Sky Lodge and Edge Spa.

claims.text: Each Earth Suite has a private terrace with an outdoor fireplace, and all offer connecting options for families.

findings.quote: Each suite offers a private terrace with an outdoor fireplace and sweeping views of a snow-covered Alexander Canyon. All offer connecting options, making these suites ideal for families or those seeking additional space.
findings.note: private terrace with fireplace and connecting options

claims.text: The Two Bedroom Signature Suites are in the central Sky Lodge and suit families or guests wanting more space.

findings.quote: With more than 2,000 square feet of indoor space, these accommodations, located in the central Sky Lodge, are perfectly suited to families or those seeking more space in which to relax
findings.note: central Sky Lodge, families or more space

claims.text: The resort is a 40-minute drive from Salt Lake City International Airport.

findings.quote: The Lodge at Blue Sky is approximately 43 miles, or a 40-minute drive, from Salt Lake City International Airport (SLC).

claims.text: The High West Distillery is on the resort's property and offers whiskey tastings and distillery tours.

findings.quote: Guests can also enjoy whiskey tastings, distillery tours and locally inspired dining at the on-property High West Distillery.
findings.note: on-property High West with tastings and tours

claims.text: Gracie's Farm supplies eggs for breakfast dishes and honey for cocktails at The Bar.

findings.quote: Eggs are collected fresh each morning and used in breakfast dishes and baked goods across the Lodge, while honey from our thriving hives sweetens craft cocktails at The Bar
findings.note: eggs for breakfast dishes, honey for cocktails at The Bar

claims.text: Edge Spa is perched on a precipice overlooking Alexander Creek.

findings.quote: Aptly named for its dramatic location perched on the side of a dramatic precipice overlooking Alexander Creek, Edge Spa
findings.note: perched on precipice overlooking Alexander Creek

claims.text: The resort has a private Ski Lounge at Park City Mountain Resort and can arrange ski transportation and equipment rentals.

findings.quote: Blue Sky offers a private Ski Lounge at Park City Mountain Resort, providing a convenient home base for days on the slopes. The resort can also arrange transportation, equipment rentals and personalized ski experiences

claims.text: The High West Distillery is on the resort's property and offers whiskey tastings and distillery tours.

findings.quote: Guests can also enjoy whiskey tastings, distillery tours and locally inspired dining at the on-property High West Distillery.
findings.note: on-property High West with tastings and tours

claims.text: Edge Sanctuary is a glamping tent in an aspen grove beside Alexander Creek, dedicated to energetic healing.

findings.quote: Tucked into a secluded aspen grove that is situated along the tranquil banks of Alexander Creek, the new Edge Sanctuary is a hidden haven that is dedicated to energetic and vibrational healing.
findings.note: aspen grove, Alexander Creek, energetic healing

findings.quote: as you relax in this cozy glamping tent

claims.text: The Tavern Breakfast Ride goes on horseback to The Tavern at Blue Sky, an original 1800s cabin where a Western-inspired breakfast is served.

findings.quote: Ride through sagebrush hills and open meadows en route to The Tavern at Blue Sky, an original 1800s cabin set within a pristine high-alpine field, where a Western-inspired breakfast awaits.
findings.note: horseback to Tavern cabin with breakfast

claims.text: Edge Spa offers vertical vinyasa, aerial yoga with silk hung from tree branches in a forest.

findings.quote: vertical vinyasa: aerial yoga which uses large swaths of silk suspended from tree branches in a secluded forest
findings.note: Edge Spa mindfulness list includes vertical vinyasa

claims.text: Private airport transfers can be arranged through the resort for an additional fee.

findings.quote: Private airport transfers can be arranged year-round through the resort for an additional fee.
